mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Badger Prairie County Park, feeling like 50 degrees, and the overnight low will be 48 degrees with no rain predicted. Keep an eye on the sky at 8:30 PM, as the space station will be visible, moving from the northwest over Verona High School toward Fitchburg, appearing halfway up the sky.

The Verona Police Department is hiring patrol officers, offering roles ranging from K9 unit work to the drone team. Additionally, residents should mark their calendars for a free e-waste drop-off event on October 17 at the recycling center.

Today, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is live music at Paddy Mac's, the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local public safety, on September 5, officers investigated a series of reports where cheese was found on vehicle windshields, identifying it as a viral social media prank.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel, so no flavor of the day is available at this time.
